newer_changes_search: The cited PIB explainer of 11 Sep 2026 shows the scheme running with unchanged terms (₹3,000 pension, ₹55-₹200 contribution, 18-40, up to 2 ha, land records as on 1 Aug 2019). No later change found.

findings.note: The explainer says farmers bring Aadhaar, bank details and mobile number to the CSC; land records are not a document to bring (eligibility is self-declared, certified by the state).
The maandhan.in snapshot is the Labour Ministry portal (mainly PM-SYM) and does not describe PM-KMY. Only official_apply_url relies on it.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable; optionally point to a PM-KMY page.
